title: Forgiving Others
definition: Forgiving Others is the Christlike release of bitterness and personal vengeance because God has forgiven us in Christ.
summary: Believers forgive because they have been forgiven by grace.
christFocus: Jesus Christ purchased forgiveness for sinners and calls His people to extend mercy to others.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Forgiving Others describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is believers forgive because they have been forgiven by grace.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Forgiving Others teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let forgiving others shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
